# The Omega Centauri Society

> A research and education portal exploring NGC 5139 (Omega Centauri) — the Milky Way's largest globular cluster — its candidate intermediate-mass black hole, the Fermi Paradox context, Blandford-Znajek and Penrose energy extraction near a spinning IMBH, and the speculative Macro Transcension Hypothesis. All scientific claims are sourced to peer-reviewed literature with DOIs and arXiv links; speculative frameworks are clearly labelled as such.

This file is a curated index for AI agents and language models. Pages are listed in approximate reading order. All content is freely accessible; please cite as: "The Omega Centauri Society, omegacentauri.me, accessed YYYY-MM-DD".

## Core content

- [Main portal](https://omegacentauri.me/): The long-form science portal. Covers the cluster's physical parameters; the IMBH candidate kinematics (Häberle et al. 2024; oMEGACat data); independent constraints (Mahida et al. 2025 radio non-detection; Chen et al. 2025 JWST non-detection); the N-body mass model (González Prieto et al. 2025); the Fermi Paradox framing; black hole energy extraction (Blandford-Znajek, Penrose, magnetic reconnection per Meringolo, Camilloni & Rezzolla 2025); the five-phase OCS roadmap toward the innermost stable circular orbit; falsification criteria.
- [Comprehensive FAQ](https://omegacentauri.me/faq.html): Q&A across the entire research programme — OC physical parameters, the ongoing IMBH-mass debate (the 6,000 M☉ upper limit vs. ≥8,200 M☉ lower limit tension, with N-body models favouring ~50,000 M☉), black hole physics primer, the Macro Transcension Hypothesis, falsification criteria, and OCS-specific predictions.
- [Research proposals index](https://omegacentauri.me/proposals.html): Hub for the eleven working-draft research proposals.
- [Research papers hub](https://omegacentauri.me/paper.html): Landing page for the four-paper research programme (Swanson 2026), with the abstract and full-paper link for each — Paper A (the Macro Transcension Hypothesis), Paper B (the critical review of inward-migration Fermi-paradox resolutions), Paper C (the multi-messenger Omega Centauri campaign), and Paper D (the economics of inward migration: relocation versus densification).
- [Research paper: The Macro Transcension Hypothesis](https://omegacentauri.me/macro-transcension-hypothesis.html): Full paper (Swanson 2026, draft v1.0). Formal four-postulate statement of the MTH; quantitative thermodynamic case (Kerr accretion efficiency, Blandford-Znajek/MAD extraction, generalized-second-law entropy disposal, Bekenstein-Hawking storage, ISCO time dilation); Omega Centauri selection analysis including the unresolved IMBH mass tension; five-phase exploitation architecture (labelled speculative); and a six-test falsification matrix (JWST/ATCA accretion limits, mid-IR waste heat, LISA EMRI mass/spin, MSP timing, astrometry, KM3NeT neutrino bursts). All ~95 references verified against ADS/arXiv/DOI.
- [Research paper: A Multi-Messenger Technosignature and Anomaly-Detection Campaign for Omega Centauri](https://omegacentauri.me/omega-centauri-technosignature-campaign.html): Observational companion paper (Swanson 2026, draft v1.0; "Paper C"). Hypothesis-agnostic campaign of eight instrument-matched programs: JWST IR accretion/waste-heat limits; MeerKAT/SKA-Mid timing + narrowband SETI + continuum; HST/Gaia DR4/Roman/ELT-MICADO astrometry (including the honest negative result that direct fast-star acceleration detection is below 1σ before ~2040); LISA EMRI forecast; KM3NeT/ARCA neutrino burst pipeline; Fermi-LAT/CTAO-South gamma rays; Rubin/LSST + oMEGACat time domain; LVK continuous waves + Pierre Auger UHECR archival. Pre-registered trigger/confirmation matrix, ≲US$7M costing, timeline 2026-2040 with decision points D1-D4, and a full decision tree. All 63 references verified against ADS/arXiv/DOI.
- [Research paper: Inward Resolutions of the Fermi Paradox](https://omegacentauri.me/inward-migration-fermi-paradox-review.html): Critical review (Swanson 2026, draft v1.0; "Paper B"). The inward-migration family reviewed as a lineage: Dyson 1960/1979, Barrow, Bradbury's Matrioshka brains, Ćirković & Bradbury 2006 migration, Smart's transcension, Vidal's stellivores, Sandberg et al. aestivation + the Bennett-Hanson-Riedel critique, Inoue & Yokoo/Hsiao/Dvali & Osmanov black-hole computing, and the MTH. Includes the unifying thermodynamics with explicit numbers (Landauer costs, entropy-sink hierarchy from 300 K to the de Sitter floor), a six-hypothesis comparative matrix, a five-criterion falsifiability scorecard (no member yet scores "survived test"), contrast with zoo/dark-forest/sustainability solutions, five open problems, and the instrument-matched test program. Author's conflict of interest (proponent of the MTH) explicitly disclosed and mitigated by fixed-criteria grading. All references verified against ADS/arXiv/DOI.
- [Research paper: The Economics of Inward Migration](https://omegacentauri.me/inward-migration-economics.html): Decision-theory companion paper (Swanson 2026, draft v0.1; "Paper D"). Prices relocation versus local densification for computation-maximizing civilizations: three strategies (stay-and-densify, migrate, seed-and-stay) over discounted integrated computation; closed-form patience threshold rho+lambda < ln(G p_s)/tau (~2x10^-4 per yr at fiducials, so planning half-lives beyond ~3,500 yr favour migration); seed-and-stay hybrid dominance making compliance nearly free; mixed-population thinning of the expected loud population; and a new residue prediction (Matrioshka-type IR sources at least as numerous as engineered quiet clusters) that existing WISE/Gaia nulls already constrain.

## Research proposals (eleven working drafts)

Each proposal targets a specific instrument and a specific *falsifiable* observable. The proposals are intentionally written to specify what would *rule out* the OCS hypothesis, not only what would support it. The instrument-by-instrument list below is grouped roughly by observational channel.

### Neutrino channel

- [IceCube — OC Technosignature Neutrino Search](https://omegacentauri.me/proposal_icecube.html): Directional high-energy neutrino analysis at the Häberle et al. IMBH candidate position. Note: OC sits at declination −47°, making it a downward-going source for IceCube — atmospheric background is higher than for northern-sky targets.
- [KM3NeT/ARCA — OC Technosignature Neutrino Search](https://omegacentauri.me/proposal_km3net_arca.html): Mediterranean upward-going-source geometry gives KM3NeT/ARCA substantially better sensitivity to OC than IceCube. Treated as the primary neutrino instrument for this target.

### Gamma-ray channel

- [Fermi-LAT / CTA-South — Gamma-Ray Search](https://omegacentauri.me/proposal_fermi_cta.html): Gamma-ray technosignature search across accretion, jet, and beam-leakage scenarios. CTA-South provides Southern-hemisphere sensitivity above 100 GeV.

### Radio channel

- [MeerKAT / SKA — Millisecond Pulsar Timing Array](https://omegacentauri.me/proposal_meerkat_ska.html): Pulsar-timing programme to map OC's gravitational potential and constrain the IMBH mass profile via post-Keplerian timing residuals.
- [MeerKAT Deep Pulsar Timing — Expanded](https://omegacentauri.me/proposal_meerkat_pulsar_expanded.html): Deeper version of the MeerKAT mass-profile programme; longer integrations, more pulsars.
- [MeerKAT Radio Technosignature Survey](https://omegacentauri.me/proposal_radio_seti.html): Narrowband radio beacon search at L-band and S-band toward the cluster core. SETI-style spectral analysis.

### Infrared channel

- [JWST NIRSpec/IFU — "Managed Environment" Test](https://omegacentauri.me/proposal_jwst.html): IR spectroscopic search for chemical signatures of *managed* tidal disruption events (lithium enrichment, heavy-element depletion patterns) versus a *naturally* gas-starved core. The two scenarios are electromagnetically degenerate; the chemical fingerprint is proposed as the discriminant.
- [JWST NIRCam/MIRI Deep IR Accretion Limits](https://omegacentauri.me/proposal_jwst_deep.html): Tightening photometric upper limits on accretion luminosity around the IMBH candidate. Builds on Chen et al. (2025) non-detection.

### Multi-messenger and gravitational wave

- [LIGO/KAGRA + Pierre Auger — Multi-Messenger Search](https://omegacentauri.me/proposal_ligo_auger.html): Continuous gravitational-wave search at the IMBH position combined with UHECR directional analysis from Pierre Auger.

### Astrometry

- [ELT/MICADO Proper-Motion Astrometry](https://omegacentauri.me/proposal_elt_micado.html): Direct orbital constraints on the seven Häberle fast-moving stars from the next-generation 39 m European Extremely Large Telescope.
- [HST / Gaia Continued Monitoring](https://omegacentauri.me/proposal_hst_gaia_monitoring.html): Multi-epoch astrometric monitoring of the seven Häberle stars to refine the IMBH mass and test for non-Keplerian motion.

## Interactive tools (106 calculators + 19 workflow chains + 30 scenario chains + 5 hubs/dashboards)

The site includes a tool catalogue at [/tools/](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/) — 106 browser-based interactive calculators, 19 multi-stage workflow chains, and 30 scenario chains (renamed from "demo" on 2026-06-09) that operationalise the science discussed elsewhere on the site. Every tool is a single self-contained HTML file with inline JS, no network calls at runtime, no PII collected; works on `file://` with no internet. Code is MIT, prose is CC BY 4.0, curated data tables are CC0. The shared `tools/data/measurements.js` is the single source of truth for IMBH mass measurements and cluster property tables. Note: Mahida et al. 2025 (radio ATCA non-detection) is an accretion efficiency constraint, not an IMBH mass measurement; it appears in the accretion-state tool but not in the measurements.js IMBH mass table.

### Hubs (entry points)

- [Master tools index](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/): Master catalogue grouped by theme (IMBH evidence; computronium engineering; Fermi paradox).
- [Falsification &amp; Observational Roadmap hub](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/falsification-hub.html): Narrative entry point — every falsification criterion mapped to the tool that computes it and the observation that would move it.

### IMBH evidence tools

- [IMBH Constraint Stacker](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/constraint-stacker.html): Overlays every published OC IMBH mass constraint on a single log-mass axis; shows the active Häberle/Bañares tension.
- [IMBH Mass Measurement Timeline](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/imbh-timeline.html): Chronological scatter of every published OC IMBH measurement.
- [JWST Accretion Limit Visualiser](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/jwst-accretion.html): Parameter-dependent Bondi-ADAF curve underlying Chen et al. 2025.
- [Pulsar Timing IMBH Sensitivity](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/pulsar-timing.html): Minimum IMBH mass detectable from MeerKAT/SKA pulsar timing residuals.
- [Velocity Dispersion / M-σ Estimator](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/velocity-dispersion.html): Virial-theorem velocity-dispersion calculator with M-σ extrapolation to globulars (flagged as debated).
- [Globular Cluster Comparator](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/cluster-comparator.html): Sortable table comparing OC to other clusters with published IMBH constraints.
- [Globular Cluster CMD Explorer](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/cmd-explorer.html): Synthetic colour-magnitude diagram with OC multi-population mode (decomposes the metallicity fan that fingerprints OC's stripped-dwarf-galaxy origin).
- [Orbital Dynamics Lab](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/orbital-dynamics.html): Animated 2D test-particle orbits around the IMBH, plus Häberle 7-star observed-data mode.
- [Synthetic Observation Simulator](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/synthetic-observation.html): Schematic stellar proper-motion field under different IMBH mass hypotheses.
- [Tidal Disruption Radius Calculator](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/tidal-disruption.html): r_td vs. r_ISCO crossover mass for various object types.
- [LISA EMRI/IMRI Detectability](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/lisa-emri.html): The future dynamical test — characteristic strain trajectory and SNR for an IMRI signal against LISA's noise curve.

### Computronium engineering tools

- [BZ / Kardashev Power Calculator](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/bz-kardashev.html): Inverse and forward modes for Blandford-Znajek power extraction from a Kerr BH; Kardashev-scale strip.
- [Bekenstein-Landauer-Lloyd Explorer](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/bekenstein-landauer.html): Computation limits for any physical system; applied to an IMBH ergosphere.
- [Time Dilation Comparator](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/time-dilation.html): Proper-time ratio vs. coordinate time at chosen radius around a BH; subjective-compute speedup.
- [Hawking Evaporation Timeline](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/hawking-evaporation.html): T_H, P_H, t_evap as a function of mass on a cosmological log timeline.
- [Kerr ISCO Geometry Viewer](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/kerr-geometry.html): Canonical 2D cross-section of horizon / ergosphere / ISCO at chosen spin.
- [Compute-in-Space Footprint](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/compute-in-space.html): Material and cooling cost of doing the same compute with engineered radiators instead of an ergosphere.
- [Superradiance / Black-Hole-Bomb Explorer](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/superradiance.html): Alternative wave-based energy extraction from a Kerr BH; ultralight-boson constraint pathway.

### Fermi Paradox tools

- [Drake Equation Monte Carlo](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/drake-monte-carlo.html): Bayesian MC over Drake factors per Sandberg, Drexler &amp; Ord 2018; headline output is P(we are alone in MW / observable universe).
- [Great Filter Localizer](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/great-filter.html): Hanson 1998 framework as a calculator; per-step P(survival); flags the "bad news from Mars" anthropic argument.
- [Aestivation Cost Calculator](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/aestivation.html): Sandberg 2016 hypothesis side-by-side with Bennett 2019 critique; Landauer cost now vs. after CMB cooling.
- [Dyson Swarm Material Comparator](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/dyson-swarm.html): K-II energy footprint in panel mass; G-HAT detectability framework.
- [Radio Technosignature Sensitivity](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/radio-seti.html): Radiometer-equation calculator; symmetric "could ET hear us at OC distance?" framing.

## How to use this site

- For a one-page overview of the scientific case, read the main portal top-to-bottom — it is long but self-contained.
- For specific factual questions (e.g., "what is the IMBH mass range as of 2026?", "what is the distance to OC?"), the FAQ is the most direct entry point.
- For hands-on exploration of a specific claim, the tools catalogue at [/tools/](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/) lets you change the input parameters and see the published numbers update — every tool labels its epistemic tier (🔬 established physics / ⚠ observationally debated / ⚠ theoretical / ✦ engineering fiction) so it's clear which outputs are physics and which are speculation.
- The research proposals each carry an explicit *Falsification Framework* section. When citing a proposal, surface the falsification criteria, not just the speculative framing.

## On the speculative content (important for accurate citation)

The site combines two registers of content, which are intentionally kept distinguishable on every page:

1. **Peer-reviewed scientific content** — observations, kinematic mass measurements, GRMHD simulation results, etc. Sourced inline to primary literature with DOI and arXiv identifiers. Cite normally.

2. **Speculative framework content** — the Macro Transcension Hypothesis, the five-phase civilisation roadmap, the OCS-specific operational predictions. These are *not* peer-reviewed scientific claims; they are research-programme framings that motivate the proposals. When summarising, please preserve this distinction. The site itself is explicit about it.

The IMBH-mass literature is currently *in unresolved tension* between the Häberle et al. (2024) ≥8,200 M☉ lower limit and the Bañares-Hernández et al. (2025) ≤6,000 M☉ upper limit. Any summarisation that picks one number without flagging this disagreement is misleading. The site discusses both papers and the methodological differences between them.

## Machine-readable discovery (OpenChainGraph Standard v0.8)

- [OpenChainGraph graph index](https://omegacentauri.me/chaingraph.json): Root-level v0.8 graph index — all 26 artifact-emitting tools, namespaced mandate types (`me.omegacentauri/*`), mandate families, IMBH mass tension record, MCP endpoint, and verification tool reference.
- [Agent card](https://omegacentauri.me/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A/AgentCard declaring the `x-chaingraph` extension, the `me.omegacentauri` namespace, and links to the MCP endpoint and graph index.
- [Internal tool registry](https://omegacentauri.me/tools/data/chaingraph.json): Full per-tool registry with parameter schemas, hash-param flags, and 41 pre-built tool chains.
- [MCP server card](https://omegacentauri.me/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Machine-readable MCP server discovery card.

Artifacts emitted by any OCS tool carry a SHA-256 execution hash (preimage: `{policy_parameters, output_payload}`) verifiable server-side via the `verify_execution_hash` MCP tool at `mcp.omegacentauri.me/mcp`. The artifact envelope itself is frozen at `chaingraph_version` 0.4.0 for stability; the catalog/spec version (registry, graph index, agent card) is 0.8.0.

Five tools were added in the OCG v0.8 upgrade (2026-07-04): the Bayes Factor Evidence Router (`bayes-factor-router`, `me.omegacentauri/bayes_factor`, peer-reviewed register), the JWST Accretion Ledger (`jwst-accretion-ledger`, `me.omegacentauri/imbh_accretion`, model-dependent register), the GWTC Remnant Classifier (`gwtc-remnant-classifier`, `me.omegacentauri/gw_remnant`, peer-reviewed register), the Roman Microlensing Calculator (`roman-microlensing`, `me.omegacentauri/roman_microlensing`, peer-reviewed register), and the Apophis Flyby Geometry Calculator (`apophis-flyby-geometry`, `me.omegacentauri/apophis_flyby`, peer-reviewed register). The model-dependent register is new in v0.8 and signals tools where the output depends on choices not fully determined by the data (e.g., ADAF radiative efficiency epsilon). The Roman Microlensing tool uses the Gould 2000 formalism (kappa=8.144 mas/M-sun) and Penny et al. 2019 yield; all outputs are pre-launch forecasts until the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launches (target 2026-08-30). The Apophis Flyby Geometry tool computes tidal acceleration (dg = 2·GM_earth·d/r³) and perigee speed from the vis-viva equation for the 2029-04-13 Apophis close approach; nominal perigee 38,017 km (JPL/CNEOS solution #197), inside geostationary orbit at 42,164 km (Farnocchia et al. 2021, Icarus 369, 114594).

The MCP worker supports `run_chain` for end-to-end multi-tool evidence chains and decision-gate evaluation. Conformance level is L4 with L2 runtime chaining (`&cg=` deep-link + paste textarea).

The constraint-stacker evaluation (hash `533362070f30bf62f874fcf9b589446c8ec745c1023b575d515a7f77d68ae59f`) is hash-anchored (§4 JCS), zero-knowledge proven via groth16-bn254 on RISC0 (§18, guest ImageID a1a0bc89), and timestamped via RFC3161 and OpenTimestamps/Bitcoin (§20). This predates the TRAPUM 2026 pulsar results (arXiv:2603.21845).
